title: Fog, walls, lights and combat setup on the left
summary: The Dungeon Master's fog, walls, lights, combat tokens and grid now sit in the setup rail, each with its options right beside it.
items: Fog brush, rectangle and polygon show Undo, Redo, Reveal all, Conceal all and Consolidate fog next to the tool; Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo fog.
Walls & doors and Lights list what is already on the map while you draw.
Combat token and Grid & scale open their own panels; Objects & inspector opens the inspector.
The More map tools button is gone because everything it held now has its own place. Players find the inspector in the tools rail.
